title_text: You'll Never Have Lunch In This Town Again
credits_text:
A Rio Redwood-Sawyer Picture
Lydia Bailey
other_text: P.S. IT'S ALL RIGHT - EAT 'EM WITH YOUR FINGERS! NOTHING'S BETTER THAN FRENCH FRIES WITH A SPRINKLE OF SALT... A GENIE SHOULD NOT FRENCH FRIES "FAST-SWEET" HUNT'S CATUP - "SWEET-FOR THE BEST!"
description: A vintage poster features a bottle of Hunt's ketchup next to a basket of French fries and a strawberry, with humorous text about eating fries.
